t: Adds support for Policy Store Aliases, Policy Names, and Policy Template Names. These are customizable identifiers that can be used in place of Policy Store ids, Policy ids, and Policy Template ids respectively in Amazon Verified Permissions APIs.
Adding documentation to user guide and API documentation for how customers can create new encrypted policy stores by passing in their customer managed key during policy store creation.

Amazon Verified Permissions now supports encryption of resources by a customer managed KMS key. Customers can now create new encrypted policy stores by passing in their customer managed key during policy store creation.
Amazon Verified Permissions / Features : Adds support for entity Cedar tags.
Update endpoint ruleset parameters casing
Amazon Verified Permissions / Features : Adds support for datetime and duration attribute values.
Amazon Verified Permissions / Features : Adds support for tagging policy stores.
Adds deletion protection support to policy stores. Deletion protection is disabled by default, can be enabled via the CreatePolicyStore or UpdatePolicyStore APIs, and is visible in GetPolicyStore.
Adds Cedar JSON format support for entities and context data in authorization requests
Adding BatchGetPolicy API which supports the retrieval of multiple policies across multiple policy stores within a single request.
Add examples for API operations in model.
This release adds OpenIdConnect (OIDC) configuration support for IdentitySources, allowing for external IDPs to be used in authorization requests.
Adds policy effect and actions fields to Policy API's.
Adding BatchIsAuthorizedWithToken API which supports multiple authorization requests against a PolicyStore given a bearer token.
Adds GroupConfiguration field to Identity Source API's
Deprecating details in favor of configuration for GetIdentitySource and ListIdentitySources APIs.
Adds description field to PolicyStore API's and namespaces field to GetSchema.
Adding BatchIsAuthorized API which supports multiple authorization requests against a PolicyStore
Improving Amazon Verified Permissions Create experience
Documentation updates for Amazon Verified Permissions.
Documentation updates for Amazon Verified Permissions. Increases max results per page for ListPolicyStores, ListPolicies, and ListPolicyTemplates APIs from 20 to 50.
This release corrects several broken links in the documentation.
This update fixes several broken links to the Cedar documentation.
Added improved descriptions and new code samples to SDK documentation.
GA release of Amazon Verified Permissions.
